title: How to Delete Your Polymarket Account

blocks.text: Polymarket is a decentralized, blockchain-based platform. Account deletion works differently here than on traditional platforms. Your profile and personal data can be removed, but certain information is permanent by nature of how blockchain technology works.
You must complete the following steps before your account can be closed:
1. Close all open positions on the platform 2. Withdraw all funds from your Polymarket wallet

content.text: Close all open positions on the platform
Withdraw all funds from your Polymarket wallet

blocks.text: Please note that you will be unable to delete an account that is still holding positions or tokens and will be prompted to withdraw before proceeding.
Once your positions are closed and funds are withdrawn, you can delete your account directly from your settings here: https://polymarket.com/settings?tab=account
Your Polymarket profile and associated personal data will be deleted in line with our Privacy Policy. Some data may be retained where required by applicable law or regulation.

Because Polymarket runs on a public blockchain, your past transaction history will remain visible on-chain even after your account is removed. This is how blockchain technology works and is not something that can be changed.
You can learn more about our privacy policy here: https://polymarket.com/privacy
If you have any questions or run into any issues, or reach us via the chat on our website or by emailing support@polymarket.com.
